conditions_by_beat_id.131: Ulf follows Ormund's direction and uses Silverwing to harm or obstruct the Blacks.
conditions_by_beat_id.133: Ulf deliberately commands Silverwing to attack a Black-aligned person, force, dragon, or position.
conditions_by_beat_id.141: Roddy personally leads or gives the order for a visible charge or major attack by his northern troops.
conditions_by_beat_id.145: Roddy is definitively killed while personally advancing, charging, or fighting in the front line.
conditions_by_beat_id.154: Black Aly personally delivers a fatal blow to a named enemy who could otherwise be captured or spared.

exclusions: Preparation, movement toward battle, a general threat, ordinary presence, an attempted strike without the preserved result, or another combatant's action does not count.
A proxy fighter or dragon does not count unless the preserved condition explicitly names the owner's command relationship to that force or dragon.
An off-screen report, recap, mention, dream, vision, memory, prediction, promotional image, or ambiguous aftermath does not count.
families.title_review_note: Each title honestly names a direct attack, charge, front-line death, or fatal blow; settlement requires the preserved actor, command relationship, target, battlefield state, and result.
